mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies over Verona Community Park with a temperature of 65 degrees. The moon is in a Waning Crescent phase, and we expect an overnight low of 61 degrees with no rain predicted.

City updates include ongoing road construction on Highway M near Highway PB for the new Aldi development. Additionally, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward, with bridge construction and trail closures planned between Lincoln and South Franklin Street from mid-September through mid-November.

There is plenty to do tomorrow, September 8. You can join Hop Haus Trivia in Verona or head over to Lake Lou-ee for Quizmasters Trivia. If you are looking further ahead, Wednesday offers the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and even more trivia options at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.

The Verona Police Department issued a media release regarding an incident from Friday, September 4. A 34-year-old Madison woman was arrested for the sexual assault of a child by a school staff member for actions reported to have occurred in 2019.
Culver's of Verona is now closed for the night. You missed out on today's Georgia Peach, but we will be back tomorrow at 10:00 AM serving up the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
